name: Occipital Condyle Fracture
definition: Fracture of one or both occipital condyles after high-energy head or cervical trauma, with variable craniovertebral stability.

investigations.principle: CT is the key diagnostic test; MRI is used for ligamentous and neural assessment when instability is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Unstable craniovertebral injury may require operative stabilization.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Modern trauma and stability management takes priority.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of one or both occipital condyles after high-energy head or cervical trauma, with variable craniovertebral stability.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
